title: Cylinder Identification Sensor Error
problem: Open or short circuit detected in the Cylinder Identification sensor.
symptoms: Erratic spark timing; Engine hard starting; Sluggish power
actions: Verify sensor wiring connection; Measure sensor resistance; Inspect cam wheel teeth; Replace sensor
location: Top engine valve cover area

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor Error
problem: No normal signal received from the crankshaft position sensor (pickup coil).
symptoms: Engine cranks but will not start; No spark at spark plug; Fuel pump runs but no ignition
actions: Test pick-up coil resistance (200-400 ohms); Clean stator magnet and pick-up sensor; Check wiring harness and connector
location: Left engine stator cover assembly

title: Intake Air Pressure Sensor Open/Short
problem: Open or short circuit detected in the intake air pressure (MAP) sensor circuit.
symptoms: Engine hard starting; Rough idling; Black smoke from exhaust; High fuel usage
actions: Verify MAP sensor connector is dry; Check 5V reference voltage; Measure sensor output voltage at idle; Inspect vacuum line
location: Throttle body or intake manifold

title: Intake Air Pressure Hose Malfunction
problem: MAP sensor vacuum hose is clogged
symptoms: detached
actions: or leaking air.
location: Erratic idle speed; Stalling; Fuel mixture rich; Engine hesitation
column10: Check vacuum hose connection to throttle body; Clean hose blockage; Replace cracked hose
column11: Connecting MAP sensor to throttle body

title: Throttle Position Sensor Open/Short
problem: Open or short circuit detected in the throttle position sensor (TPS) circuit.
symptoms: Engine hesitates when opening throttle; Jerking at low speeds; Stalling at idle
actions: Verify TPS connector is secure; Verify 5V reference supply; Measure TPS resistance sweep; Adjust or replace TPS
location: Right side of the throttle body

title: Throttle Position Sensor Stuck
problem: Throttle Position Sensor (TPS) signal does not change or is stuck in position.
symptoms: Engine speed does not increase; Stalling during throttle opening; Check engine light
actions: Check for mechanical throttle linkage binding; Verify TPS shaft rotation; Check voltage change during throttle twist
location: Right side of the throttle body

title: Sidestand Switch Circuit Fault
problem: Open circuit or disconnected lead detected in the sidestand switch line.
symptoms: Engine cuts out instantly when putting bike in gear; Engine won't crank with stand down
actions: Inspect sidestand switch and spring; Clean switch contacts with contact cleaner; Check connector behind side panel; Replace switch
location: Near side stand pivot mount

title: MAP and Atmospheric Pressure Sensor correlation
problem: ECU detects mismatch between MAP sensor and Atmospheric Pressure sensor.
symptoms: Rough engine running; Sluggish acceleration; High fuel consumption; MIL on
actions: Check vacuum hoses on both sensors; Verify sensors connector and harness integrity; Measure voltage outputs at atmospheric pressure
location: Inside intake or under fuel tank

title: Coolant Temperature Sensor Open/Short
problem: Open or short circuit detected in the engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor circuit.
symptoms: Engine temperature gauge blinking/max; Radiator fan runs continuously or not at all; Rich startup running
actions: Verify coolant level; Test ECT sensor resistance (cold vs hot); Check connector pin corrosion; Replace ECT sensor
location: Cylinder head or near thermostat housing

title: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Open/Short
problem: Open or short circuit detected in the intake air temperature (IAT) sensor circuit.
symptoms: Slight loss of engine power; Black smoke under load; Hesitation on acceleration
actions: Check IAT connector; Verify sensor resistance (approx 2k ohms at room temp); Check wiring harness
location: Inside or on the air filter box

title: Atmospheric Pressure Sensor Open/Short
problem: Open or short circuit detected in the atmospheric pressure sensor circuit.
symptoms: Slight flat spot in mid-RPM; Poor high altitude performance; Rich air-fuel mixture
actions: Verify sensor connector; Measure sensor output voltage (should vary with altitude); Check harness wires
location: Under the seat or near battery

title: O2 Sensor Circuit Malfunction / Sluggish
problem: ECU detects no signal or sluggish response from the O2 / Lambda sensor.
symptoms: Poor fuel economy; Black carbon on exhaust; Sluggish throttle; Check engine light on
actions: Check O2 sensor wiring for burns/rubs on exhaust; Clean carbon off sensor tip; Check for exhaust leaks; Replace O2 sensor
location: Exhaust header pipe close to cylinder head

title: Engine Temperature Sensor Error
problem: Open or short circuit in engine cylinder head temperature sensor (air cooled models).
symptoms: Engine runs rich on warm-up; Sluggish response; Cylinder head overheating
actions: Check sensor connector; Test sensor resistance under different temperatures; Inspect sensor wiring harness
location: Screw-in sensor on the cylinder block/head

title: Lean Angle Sensor Latch-Up
problem: Lean angle sensor detects vehicle has fallen or is tilted beyond safe limit (latch-up).
symptoms: Engine cuts out instantly; Fuel pump will not prime; Vehicle will not restart
actions: Set motorcycle fully upright; Reset ignition switch (turn key OFF then ON); Check sensor mounting position
location: Under the seat or near the battery

title: Ignition Coil Primary Circuit Malfunction (Cyl 1)
problem: Open or short circuit detected in the primary lead of the ignition coil for Cylinder 1.
symptoms: Engine misfire; Hard starting; Complete loss of spark; Engine backfiring
actions: Check ignition coil primary resistance (0.5-3 ohms); Verify HT lead is secure; Check wire harness from ECU to coil
location: Under fuel tank near spark plug 1

title: Ignition Coil Primary Circuit Malfunction (Cyl 2)
problem: Open or short circuit in primary lead of ignition coil 2 (multi-cylinder models).
symptoms: Misfire on cylinder 2; Rough running; Loss of power
actions: Check coil 2 primary and secondary resistance; Verify harness to ECU; Swap coils to test
location: Under fuel tank near spark plug 2

title: Ignition Coil Primary Circuit Malfunction (Cyl 3)
problem: Open or short circuit in primary lead of ignition coil 3 (multi-cylinder models).
symptoms: Misfire on cylinder 3; Rough running; Loss of power
actions: Check coil 3 primary and secondary resistance; Verify harness to ECU; Swap coils to test
location: Under fuel tank near spark plug 3

title: Ignition Coil Primary Circuit Malfunction (Cyl 4)
problem: Open or short circuit in primary lead of ignition coil 4 (multi-cylinder models).
symptoms: Misfire on cylinder 4; Rough running; Loss of power
actions: Check coil 4 primary and secondary resistance; Verify harness to ECU; Swap coils to test
location: Under fuel tank near spark plug 4

title: Idle Speed Control (ISC) Malfunction
problem: The Idle Speed Control system is unable to maintain the calibrated target idle speed.
symptoms: High idle speed; Idle speed hunting (fluctuating); Engine stalling at stops
actions: Clean carbon build-up in throttle body and ISC bypass; Check ISC electrical connector; Perform ISC reset
location: Mounted on the throttle body

title: Decompression Solenoid Open/Short
problem: Open or short circuit in the automatic decompression solenoid valve.
symptoms: Hard engine cranking; High battery load during starting; Starter motor binding
actions: Check solenoid valve connector; Measure solenoid internal coil resistance; Check for mechanical stickiness
location: Cylinder head valve train area

title: Fuel Injector Open/Short Circuit (Cyl 1)
problem: Open or short circuit detected in the fuel injector electrical circuit for Cylinder 1.
symptoms: Engine cranks but does not start; Spark exists but no fuel; Spark plug remains completely dry
actions: Check injector connector; Measure injector coil resistance (11-16 ohms); Verify ECU pulsing signal; Replace injector
location: Attached to the throttle body runner

title: Secondary Throttle Position Sensor Error
problem: Open or short circuit in secondary throttle position sensor (sub-TPS) circuit.
symptoms: Lumpy throttle response; Delayed acceleration; Revs hanging
actions: Verify sub-TPS connector is tight; Check signal sweep with multimeter; Calibrate sub-TPS position
location: Side of throttle body assembly

title: Lean Angle Sensor Open/Short
problem: Open or short circuit detected in the lean angle sensor circuit.
symptoms: Tilt safety system inactive; Fault lamp stays illuminated
actions: Check sensor connector; Test sensor output voltage; Inspect wiring harness for rub points
location: Under the seat or near the battery

title: Speed Sensor / Clutch Switch Error
problem: No speed signal or clutch switch signal received by the ECU.
symptoms: Speedometer displays 0 or behaves erratically; Starter will not crank in gear with clutch pulled
actions: Clean speed sensor tip and tone ring; Check clutch switch continuity when lever is pulled; Check wiring harness
location: Rear wheel hub or left handlebar switch

title: Fuel System Voltage Fault
problem: Incorrect or unstable voltage supplied to the fuel pump or injector circuit.
symptoms: Engine cranks but won't start; Stalling under load; Poor fuel pressure
actions: Check fuel pump relay and main fuse; Measure voltage at pump connector (should match battery); Check system grounding
location: Under seat or in main wiring harness

title: EEPROM Read/Write Error
problem: An internal error occurred while reading or writing to the ECU memory.
symptoms: Erratic engine behavior; Multiple sensor codes; Fault light illuminated
actions: Disconnect battery for 10 minutes to reset; Verify battery voltage; Replace ECU if error persists
location: Under the seat or behind fairing

title: Power Supply / Charging Fault
problem: Charging voltage supplied to the system is abnormal (too low or too high).
symptoms: Dim dashboard lights; Speedometer resetting; ABS disabled; Weak starting
actions: Test battery voltage (12.6V rest
location: 14V running); Test regulator/rectifier output; Check stator coil resistance

title: Fuel Injector Open/Short Circuit (Cyl 2)
problem: Open or short circuit in fuel injector circuit 2 (multi-cylinder models).
symptoms: Engine runs on one cylinder; Misfire; Loss of power; Running rough
actions: Test injector 2 coil resistance (11-16 ohms); Verify wiring connections; Test ECU injector pulse
location: Attached to the throttle body runner

title: Air Plug / Sub-Throttle Actuator Malfunction
problem: Open or short circuit in air plug or secondary throttle actuator control circuit.
symptoms: Engine hesitation; Stalling; Sudden lack of top-end power
actions: Inspect sub-throttle servo motor connector; Test actuator resistance; Verify butterfly valve moves smoothly
location: On the side of the throttle body

title: ECU Memory Malfunction
problem: Internal RAM or ROM memory failure detected in the engine control unit.
symptoms: Vehicle will not start; Complete lack of response; Fault light stays on
actions: Test battery voltage; Check main ECU grounds; Replace ECU if internal fault persists
location: Under the seat or main wiring harness

title: Electronic Throttle Valve Servo Motor Error
problem: Open or short circuit in the Electronic Throttle Valve (ETV) motor circuit.
symptoms: Engine goes into limp home mode; No response from throttle twist; Idle holds high
actions: Check throttle valve actuator connector; Check wiring harness; Test servo motor internal winding
location: Attached to throttle body

title: YCC-T System Actuator Error
problem: Yamaha Chip Controlled Throttle (YCC-T) system detects actuator movement error.
symptoms: Engine enters safety mode; Throttle response extremely slow or non-responsive; MIL light on
actions: Check throttle body clean status (remove carbon sticky); Verify return springs; Check throttle cables
location: Throttle body assembly

title: Idling Stop System Malfunction
problem: A malfunction was detected in the automatic idling stop (Stop-Start) system.
symptoms: Stop-Start system inactive; Warning indicator blinking on dashboard
actions: Verify battery charge status; Check handlebar switch; Verify engine is up to operating temp; Check SGCU connector
location: Main frame / front shield area

title: Idle Stop Starter Motor Warning
problem: Abnormal current or signal detected when restarting engine via Idle Stop system.
symptoms: Engine fails to restart from idle stop; Dashboard warning light flashing
actions: Verify starter generator brushes; Test battery power under load; Check starter relay circuit
location: Near battery or starter generator

title: Engine Oil Temperature / Pressure Switch Error
problem: ECU detects low oil pressure or oil temperature sensor circuit failure.
symptoms: Oil warning light on; Engine enters engine-protection mode (power reduction)
actions: Verify engine oil level immediately; Check oil pressure switch wiring; Verify sensor resistance
location: Bottom engine crankcase area
